marks.gloss_en: one who circumcised and did not uncover [the corona] -- it is as if he had not circumcised
Rav: [the mishna means] flesh that covers most of the HEIGHT of the corona
the mishna's clause: [if] he circumcised but did not uncover...

and the one who blesses says: 'who sanctified the beloved from the womb, set a statute in his flesh, and sealed his offspring with the sign of the holy covenant; therefore, as reward for this, the living God our portion commanded to save the beloved of our flesh from destruction, for the sake of His covenant that He set in our flesh. Blessed are You, Lord, who establishes the covenant'
one who circumcises converts says: 'Blessed are You, Lord our God, King of the universe, who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us concerning circumcision'
one who circumcises slaves says: '...who sanctified us with His commandments and commanded us concerning circumcision'
the mishna's clause: and if he [the child] was fleshy, etc.
a child encumbered with flesh who, when it hardens, does not appear circumcised must be circumcised again
what is between them? 'appears and does not appear' is between them
דתניא: אין בין יום טוב לשבת אלא אוכל נפש בלבד; רבי יהודה מתיר אף מכשירי אוכל נפש (kind tanya_kevatei: no kind names a bare דתניא)
רבי אליעזר סבר לה כרבי יהודה -- he permits it on Yom Tov as a facilitator of food preparation, as R' Yehuda does (דתניא)
R' Eliezer holds like R' Yehuda [on facilitators of food preparation]

השתא רבי אליעזר אוסופי אהל עראי לא מוספינן, למיעבד לכתחלה שרי?! -- R' Eliezer forbids even adding to a temporary tent (the window-shutter mishna, דתנן, as R' Yochanan reads it); how can he permit suspending a strainer [making one at the outset] on Yom Tov?
say we heard R' Yehuda permit facilitators that cannot be done on the eve of Yom Tov; facilitators that can be done on the eve -- did you hear him [permit them]?!
what we heard from R' Yehuda: [he permits] facilitators that cannot be done on the eve of Yom Tov
דרבי אליעזר עדיפא מדרבי יהודה -- R' Eliezer's [permission] goes further than R' Yehuda's
R' Eliezer's [permission] goes further than R' Yehuda's
R' Eliezer (the mishna): one may suspend the strainer on Yom Tov
a window shutter -- R' Eliezer: when it is tied and hanging, one may shutter with it
all agree that one may not make a temporary tent at the outset on Yom Tov
אלא מעתה -- if suspending a strainer incurs a sin-offering, then one who hangs a jug on a peg would also be liable?! (unanswered; Abaye goes on: אלא אמר אביי, מדרבנן היא)
the lemma: Chachamim say [one may not suspend the strainer on Yom Tov]
